summary: Innovation Beverage Group (Nasdaq: IBG), an Australian foreign private issuer, disclosed two Nasdaq compliance updates via Form 6-K. The delinquency letter (May 19, 2026) over its late FY2025 Form 20-F was cured by the September 17, 2026 filing, and Nasdaq closed the matter September 18, 2026. Separately, a September 22, 2026 letter notified IBG it fails the $2,500,000 minimum stockholders' equity standard under Rule 5550(b)(1), with reported equity of negative $1,469,914 and no alternative-standard cure. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or deadline stated. Watch for a compliance plan, equity raise, or delisting risk.
